decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views plus a full-size rear orbit to read the badge. Individually modelled keycaps with legends, trackball, floppy slot, screen bezel and a full rear I/O panel with parallel, serial and VGA ports. The underside shows a proper service-panel layout with vents. Yellowed beige plastic is convincingly period-correct.
limitations: Lid badge reads SENNETZ MIKROPER, an invented brand rather than a real manufacturer; underside carries generic inventory labels.
Screen is blank and the hinge is fixed at one open angle.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Opening belt cover reveals modelled stepped pulleys and a belt, the top view shows the full drive train, and the chuck, drill bit, three-spoke feed handle, adjustable table, motor and coiled power cable are all separate. Cast green enamel with edge wear is consistent all round. 58.5k tris, the heaviest in this batch.
limitations: 58.5k triangles; decimate if you need it as a background prop.
Belt cover is modelled open and the feed handle is in a fixed position.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Open upper shelving with pierced geometric galleries, two drawers and a cupboard with a cast brass ring pull below. Carved detail is real geometry, visible in the raking orbits. Back and bottom views confirm a properly closed carcass with plausible plain rear panelling. 15.7k tris.
limitations: Rear panel is deliberately plain, so avoid placing it facing camera.
Drawers and cupboard door are closed and not rigged.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Folding A-frame with a real hinge, carry handle cut-out and printed panels on both faces, confirmed in the top view. Generic CAUTION / WET FLOOR text and a standard slip pictogram with no branding. The 4 is for materials: the underside in the bottom view shows smeared scan texture.
limitations: Underside texture is visibly smeared from the scan; it is hidden when the sign stands normally.
Only 228 triangles, so the hinge and handle cut-out are hard-edged.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Five pale timber planks in a welded black steel frame with a lower stretcher; every board has real thickness, confirmed in the front-left orbit and the top view. The bottom view shows the plank undersides and frame feet properly closed. Clean modern lines with convincing wood grain. Only 4.3k tris.
limitations: Shelves are fixed and cannot be re-spaced without editing the mesh.
Frame welds are not modelled, so extreme close-ups look simplified.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Pitted citrus rind is carried in geometry and normal map and stays convincing from every angle, with a correctly modelled stem scar on top and blossom nub underneath rather than a mirrored sphere. Green-to-yellow ripeness variation is photographic. 8.1k tris and only 2.8 MB.
limitations: Whole fruit only; no cut or wedged variant.
Rind has a baked specular sheen that can look waxy under a hard key light.
